name: Typescale
title: typescale.io
shortDescription: Typescale is a plugin designed for Figma, XD, and Penpot that allows users to generate a modular scale for typography with ease. Ideal for designers, this tool simplifies the process of creating a typographic scale by multiplying a base font size by a chosen ratio. Users can quickly adjust the scale to achieve subtle or dramatic differences in their design projects. An example use case is a designer working on a digital ad campaign who needs to establish a visually appealing hierarchy in text elements.
pros: Easy integration with popular design tools
Flexible scaling options for different design needs
